products.title: Pi 5 Air Case
products.description: A compact, ventilated enclosure concept that keeps your Raspberry Pi project tidy and its connections within reach. Made for a desktop setup, a small home server, or your next weekend experiment.

products.title: Loop Cable Organizer
products.description: Three simple arches give loose charging cables a place to live. A small, sculptural detail for the edge of your desk, your bedside table, or wherever cables tend to disappear.

products.title: Scout FPV Frame
products.description: An open-frame concept for experimenting with quadcopter layouts and component placement. A practical starting point for bench prototypes and learning projects, with room to adapt mounting points to your hardware.

products.title: Node Project Box
products.description: A considered enclosure concept for sensor nodes and microcontroller projects. Internal mounting posts and a removable lid help turn a loose collection of wires into a tidy, approachable object.

products.title: Articulate Arm Parts
products.description: A customizable printed parts concept for a desktop robotic arm: structural links, servo brackets and gripper components. Share your servo model, reach and mounting layout to shape the parts around your project.

products.title: Botanical Wall Triptych
products.description: Three coordinated geometric botanical panels designed to bring depth and rhythm to a living room, workspace, or hallway. The lightweight printed relief creates soft shadows while keeping installation simple.

products.title: Angle Charge Mobile Stand
products.description: A compact sculptural stand that holds your phone at a useful viewing angle while guiding its charging cable through the base. Made for video calls, recipes, timers, and an uncluttered desk.
